name: First Trust Exchange-Traded Fund VIII FT Vest Laddered U.S. Eq
name_en: First Trust Exchange-Traded Fund VIII FT Vest Laddered U.S. Eq
desc: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by providing investors with U.S. large-cap equity market exposure that is subject to predetermined upside caps while attempting to limit downside risk through a laddered portfolio of four FT Vest U.S. Equity Equal Weight Buffer ETFs (the "Underlying ETFs"). Under normal conditions, it will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any investment borrowings) in investments that provide exposure to equity securities issued by U.S. companies. It is non-diversified.
